title: Function card
responsibility: Shows a linked helper invocation and a smaller Used In row linking up to three consumers.

inputs.name: ExplorerFunctionCard.row
inputs.description: The function at the viewed revision, including sample arguments and up to three distinct component, service or model consumer links.

inputs.name: ExplorerFunctionCard.nav
inputs.description: Navigation that keeps the selected branch and commit when opening the function or a consumer.

outputs.name: ExplorerFunctionCard
outputs.description: A clickable example invocation and smaller Used In row. Up to three per-helper consumer links retain revision scope; absent eligible consumers show a dash.
